Risk Description: Incomplete billing records or null entries in TotalCharges causing ETL pipeline crashes.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement automated type coercion, regex whitespace cleaning, and unit test assertions during batch ingestion.
Contingency Plan: Fallback to previous validated snapshot and alert data engineering.

Risk Description: Streamlit dashboard performance degradation when loading datasets exceeding 100k records.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement Streamlit caching (@st.cache_data), backend data aggregation, and parquet columnar compression.
Contingency Plan: Migrate backend queries to indexed SQLite/DuckDB engine.

Risk Description: Customer Success team fails to act on high-risk retention alerts due to workflow friction.
Mitigation Strategy: Establish automated email/Slack alerts, SLA tracking (48hr contact window), and weekly operational check-ins.
Contingency Plan: Escalate unattended high-MRR risk accounts to Department Head.

Risk Description: Exposure of Customer PII (Personally Identifiable Information) in dashboard views.
Mitigation Strategy: Tokenize customer identifiers, mask phone numbers/names, and restrict export permissions.
Contingency Plan: Revoke public endpoint access and apply column-level masking.

Risk Description: False positive churn flags leading to unnecessary discounting and margin erosion.
Mitigation Strategy: Fine-tune heuristic risk threshold bands (High > 70%) and restrict high discounts only to long-tenure accounts.
Contingency Plan: Require manager approval for discounts exceeding 20%.
